- No visible lesions, spots, wilting, or mold at this scale.
- Key observation: The entire soybean field remains conspicuously green and dense when the season context (mature corn background) suggests soybeans should be approaching maturity.
- Green_stem_disorder matches: "All or part of the soybean plant remains green while the rest of the plant or neighboring plants mature" — "stems remain moist while pods and seeds have ripened."
- The Green_stem_disorder reference confirms this appearance: green stems/leaves persisting while surrounding material has matured/dried.
- Downy_mildew and BPMV both require leaf-level symptoms (spots, mottling) not visible here.
